stories.title: ‎CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions

en.title: CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is requesting feedback from market participants on proposed regulatory provisions for algorithmic trading. The 30-day consultation period ends October 24, 2026, with the aim of enhancing market integrity and efficiency while preventing disruption.
